hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) google-java-format --replace "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
